correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md at blob a565ef3a51dc21017604939075d3d5caa98f5950 uses characteristic polynomial (lambda²+a)(1+tau lambda/q)^q−b with a>b>0. At imaginary lambda=i omega, phase forces q arctan(tau omega/q)=j pi, j<q/2; hence q=1,2 have no thresholds, q=3,4 one and q=5,6 two. Crossing derivative has real part with sign -(-1)^j, so odd crossing destabilizes and even restabilizes; tau1<tau2 by tan monotonicity and opposite denominator shifts. Independent recomputation at a=4,b=2 returned q5 thresholds 1.6768703772/7.6996347832 and q6 1.5739820059/5.2165696032. This is linear spectral, not nonlinear stability.
